desk.headline: Revenue up 3% to R$3.69bn, just under estimates; adjusted net income down 15.5% on credit losses and costs; no guidance

numbers.eps_basis: adjusted basic, continuing operations (R$ per share)

results: Total revenue and income rose 3.3% to R$3.69bn, slightly below the R$3.71bn estimate; credit revenue more than doubled to R$396m.
Adjusted gross profit fell 8% as loan-loss provisions rose to R$197m (from R$86m) and service costs, including software spending, climbed.
Adjusted pre-tax profit fell 16% to R$635m and adjusted net income 15.5% to R$542m; adjusted EPS slipped 2.5% to R$2.33, cushioned by buybacks.
Payment volume growth sped up to 5.1%, helped by Pix QR code (+45%), while card volume fell 2.7%; active clients rose 5.4% to 5.1m.
Loans over 90 days late rose to 9.9% of the book (5.0% a year ago); early arrears improved from Q2. Buybacks were R$212m in the quarter.

guidance.summary: StoneCo gave no financial outlook in its results release.

watch: Whether credit quality improves as the loan book seasons, with over-90-day arrears near 10%.
Margin pressure from higher service, software and selling costs.
Pace of buybacks after adjusted net cash fell to R$421m.
